paite: Huai laltutphah tung a tupa khut taklam ah laibuzial, asunglam leh apolam kigelh chiamtehna sagih a kichiamteh ka mu hi.
heading: Laibuzial Leh Belamnou
english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

paite: Angel hat khat in aw ngaihtak in, "Kua ahia laibuzial hong a, huai a chiamtehnate phel tham?" chi a puangkhia ka mu hi.
english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

paite: Huan van tung hi in, leitung hiam, ahihkeileh lei nuai ah leng huai laibuzial hong thei hiam, ahihkeileh atung en thei kuamah a-om kei hi.
english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

paite: Huchi in huai laibuzial hong a sim tak hiam, ahihkeileh atung en tak kuamah a-om louh ziak in ka kapkap hi.
english: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

paite: Huan upate lak a khat in ka kiang ah, "Kap ke'nla ngai in, humpinelkai, Judah nam a, David Zung in, laibuzial hong thei ding leh huai a chiamtehna sagihte phel thei ding in avualzouta," achi hi.
english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

paite: Huan huai laltutphah leh huai thil hing lite leh huai upate lai ah thahsa hileh kilawm, Belamnou, kii sagih leh mit sagih nei dingh ka mu a, huai mit sagihte Pathian kha sagih leitung tengteng a sawlkhiakte ahi uhi.
english: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

paite: Amah ahong pai a, laltutphah tung a tupa khut taklam a kipan laibuzial ala hi.
english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

paite: Huai laibuzial alaktak in, thil hing lite leh upa sawmnih-le-lite, gosem khat chiat leh dangka-eng belhbute gimnamtui a dim chiat tawi in, Belamnou ma ah abokkhup ua, huaite gimnamtui misiangthoute thumna ahi.
english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

paite: Huan la thak khat asa uhi: "Laibuzial la a, huai a chiamtehnate phel tham na hi; thah in na omta a, chi chih leh pau chih leh michih leh nam chih a mite Pathian a ding a na sisan a na lei tak ziak in.
english: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

paite: Ka Pathian kiang uah amau lalgam leh siampute hi ding in na bawl a; amaute'n leitung ah vai ahawm ding uh," chi in.
english: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

paite: Huan ka etleh, laltutphah leh thil hingte leh upate kimvel ah, angel tampi aw ka za hi. Atamdan uh singkhat mun singkhat leh asang mun sang tampi ahi uh;
english: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

paite: Amau aw ngaihtak in: "Thah a om, Belamnou in hatnate, leh hauhsaknate, leh thilhihtheihnate, leh zahtakhuainate, leh thupinate, leh vualzawlnate mu tham na hi,' chi in akikou uhi.
english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

paite: Huan thilsiam khempeuh van a omte, leitung a omte, lei nuai a omte, tuipi tung a omte leh amau a thil omte tengteng in, "Laltutphah tung a tupa leh Belamnou kiang ah; Vualzawlnate, zahtakhuainate, thupinate leh vaihawmnate, tangtawn tangtawn in om hen," achih uh ka za hi.
english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”

paite: Huan thil hing lite'n, "Amen!" achi ua, huan upate abokkhup ua, abia uhi.
english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
